question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

To get purple with rage
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. 'To become very angry'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To get purple with rage"** means to become extremely angry. (गुस्से से लाल होना)

 
 
• **Example: **When he saw the mess in his room, he got purple with rage.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. 'To become very angry'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To get nowhere in life **(जीवन में कहीं नहीं पहुंचना): Making no progress or achieving nothing significant in life.

 
 
• **Example:** Without hard work, you will get nowhere in life.
 
 
 
• **To fight over small things **(छोटी-छोटी बातों पर लड़ना): Arguing about trivial or insignificant matters.
 
 
• **Example:** They always fight over small things like who gets to sit in the front seat.
 
 
 
• **To bring no harm** (कोई नुकसान नहीं पहुंचाना): Causing no damage or hurt.
 
 
• **Example:** The policy changes are designed to bring no harm to the environment.
